description: Form field: a label (with optional required marker), the hint or error, then its control, wired together with `aria-describedby`. Copy: the label names the value, not the input — "Work email", not "Enter your email". The hint is a rule that applies before typing; the error is what happened and what to do — "Add a country code", never "Invalid".

props.name: label
props.description: What the control is asking for, in the reader's words. Required, and it is the field's whole reason to exist: a control with no label announces only its current value, so a screen reader hears "Annual leave" and never learns what question that answers.

props.name: htmlFor
props.description: Links the label to a control id (for native inputs/textarea).

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the field as required, to the reader and to the control. Use it when most of the form is optional; when most of it is required, mark the few that are not with `optional` instead.

props.name: optional
props.description: Marks the MINORITY. In a form where most fields are required, the few that are not say so; a star on every field tells nobody anything.

props.name: error
props.description: Validation message, above the control. Announced, and described-by wired.

props.name: hint
props.description: Quiet hint above the control, replaced by `error` when there is one.

props.name: count
props.description: The one thing that belongs UNDER the control: a `<CharacterCount>`, which is a running total of what was typed rather than an instruction.
